estimand: Spearman correlation in the fixed 25-outlet observed panel

interpretation.analytic: Independent normal draws from released outlet score and sigma; marginal-error approximation because analytic cross-outlet covariance is unavailable.
interpretation.membership: Fixed; no outlet resampling because inference is scoped to the observed purposive panel.
interpretation.model_perturbation: Joint released FrIdeo perturbation of family evidence and shrinkage, including shared panel re-standardisation.
